_comment: Tier-2: the ROM application works with StructuralMechanics and FluidDynamics. A negative control (NoSuchKratosApplication) proves the import probe discriminates.  Pitfall (kratos.rom #3). NOTE ON THE WRITTEN SIGNAL: this claim carries one of the five shared boilerplate Signal suffixes used across the Kratos catalog, which does not describe what actually happens. The real signal is recorded below and in the fixture output. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). All three import on this stack — RomApplication is pip-reachable at 10.4.3, unlike several sibling optimisation/reduction applications. The written Signal ('solver reports Convergence is not achieved') describes nothing about this claim; what is checkable is that the three modules coexist in one interpreter, which is what 'works with' requires. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
